item.title: Ceramic Wallpaper BM-002
item.description:
|## Model BM-002 — Ceramic Wallpaper

Product Overview

BM-002 is ceramic-style wallpaper — and it’s becoming one of our most popular products for Nigerian interior projects. It gives you the look of ceramic tile without the weight, cost, or complicated installation. Made from high-quality non-woven fabric with a ceramic-effect finish. Ideal for hotel lobbies, restaurant walls, office reception areas, and residential living spaces.

What Nigerian Interior Designers Love About It

Looks like tile, feels like wallpaper. You get the textured, dimensional look of ceramic cladding, but it rolls out and hangs like wallpaper. Huge time and labor savings compared to actual tiling.

item.title: Construction Adhesive BM-005
item.description:
|## Model BM-005 — Construction Adhesive (MS Polymer)

Product Overview

BM-005 is an MS Polymer-based construction adhesive — and it’s the product I recommend when you need something that bonds almost anything to anything. Unlike solvent-based adhesives that smell strong and can damage certain materials, MS Polymer is clean, low-odor, and incredibly strong. We ship this to Nigeria for everything from fixing baseboards to bonding wall panels to concrete.

Why MS Polymer?

Bonds without priming. MS Polymer adhesive grabs onto concrete, wood, metal, ceramic, plastic, stone — almost any clean surface. No need for separate primer on most surfaces. Saves time on site.

item.title: PVC Ceiling Panel BM-006
item.description:
|## Model BM-006 — PVC Ceiling Panel

Product Overview

BM-006 is a PVC ceiling panel — probably the most popular ceiling material in Nigerian construction right now. It’s lightweight, easy to install, waterproof, and doesn’t need painting. We ship these by the container load to Nigeria. If you’re building or renovating, this is the ceiling material that makes sense for the Nigerian climate.

Why PVC Ceiling Panels Dominate in Nigeria

100% waterproof. Nigeria’s rainy season means high humidity indoors. Gypsum ceilings absorb moisture and sag. PVC panels? They don’t care about moisture. No sagging, no staining, no mold. Wipe them down with a cloth and they look new again.

item.title: Tile Adhesive Standard BM-001
item.description:
|## Model BM-001 — Tile Adhesive Standard

Product Overview

BM-001 is our standard tile adhesive, and honestly, it’s the workhorse of Nigerian construction sites. I’ve seen countless bags of this go through Apapa port — it’s trusted by tile fitters from Lagos to Kano. If you’re tiling walls or floors in any Nigerian building project, this is the adhesive you need. Cement-based with polymer additives for better bonding strength.

Why BM-001 Works for Nigeria

Strong grip on all surfaces. Whether you’re fixing ceramic tiles on block walls, concrete floors, or screeded surfaces — BM-001 bonds hard. No tiles popping off after a few months. The polymer additives give it better adhesion than straight cement.

item.title: Wall Putty Powder BM-004
item.description:
|## Model BM-004 — Wall Putty Powder

Product Overview

BM-004 is wall putty powder — and if you’re doing interior finishing in Nigeria, this is an essential product. Before you paint any wall, you need a smooth surface. That’s what this putty does. It fills minor imperfections, levels out rough block work or plaster, and gives you that smooth, professional finish that clients expect. Cement-based with polymer reinforcement for strong adhesion and minimal shrinkage.

item.title: Waterproof Coating BM-003
item.description:
|## Model BM-003 — Waterproof Coating

Product Overview

This is one of our biggest sellers to Nigeria — and it’s easy to see why. BM-003 is an acrylic polymer waterproof coating that protects roofs and walls from the heavy rains that hit most of Nigeria from April to October. If you’ve dealt with leaking roofs, damp walls, or water stains on ceilings, this is the solution. It’s a liquid membrane that dries to form a seamless, flexible waterproof barrier.
